applies_to: KATHREIN wallboxes with the Modbus server enabled (register mapping version 0x0001, document release 1.1).
summary: KATHREIN wallboxes include a Modbus TCP server, disabled at the factory, that lets an energy manager read the charger state and set the charging current. This map covers the identity strings, device info and phase mapping, the UTC timestamp, the EVSE, error, PP and CP states, relay state, granted current and power, session duration and energy, and the EMS control block with its timeout fallback.

addressing.note: Addresses are printed in hex and go on the wire unchanged. The table starts with register 0x0000 (mapping version), which cannot exist in 1-based numbering, so the printed numbers are protocol addresses: 0x00A2 is requested as 162 decimal.

source.title: KATHREIN-Wallbox - ModBus-Server - Register-Mapping
source.pages: p. 2 (interface, data types, function codes), pp. 3-7 (holding register table)

notes: KATHREIN does not host this register mapping publicly; the linked copy is the unaltered release 1.1 document posted on the Symcon community forum.
Word order: the data-type table says integer types are stored big-endian with the most significant register first, so UINT32 and UINT64 values are high word first (ABCD).

Left out: the meter block 0x0030-0x005C (voltages, currents, powers, power factors, total energy). These are FLOAT32 values and the document only says they follow IEEE 754; the integer word-order rule is not stated for floats.
Left out: tariff registers 0x006B-0x006D and the reserved BINARY blocks, which the document marks as reserved for future use.
Only holding registers are answered: read with function 03, write with 06 or 16.

registers.name: Header: Mapping-Version
registers.description: Version of this register mapping (currently 0x0001).

registers.name: Device: Number
registers.description: Article number text, format 620xxxxx(-yyyy).

registers.name: Device: Type
registers.description: Type text, format ACxx(E).

registers.name: Device: Serial
registers.description: Serial number text, format G0Rxxxxxxx.

registers.name: Device: Info
registers.description: Power class, cable or socket, calibration-law version and relay capability.

bits.0: Power class bit 0 (0x0001 = 11 kW, 3 x 16 A)
bits.1: Power class bit 1 (0x0002 = 22 kW, 3 x 32 A)
bits.15: Relay capability: L1, L2 and L3

registers.name: Device: Line-Mapping
registers.description: Phase rotation the wallbox is wired with.

registers.name: Device: Timestamp (UTC)
registers.description: Unix time: seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.

registers.name: EVSE: Status
registers.description: Charging session state.

registers.name: EVSE: Error-State
registers.description: Active fault flags; 0 = no error.

registers.name: EVSE: PP-State
registers.description: Plug version: cable rating from the PP resistor in amps; fixed-cable version reads 0.

values.0: Cable not connected (socket version) / fixed cable mounted (cable version)

registers.name: EVSE: CP-State
registers.description: Control pilot state; other values mean undefined or error.

registers.name: EVSE: Relais-State
registers.description: Which line relays are closed; 0 = all off.

registers.name: EVSE: Granted Current
registers.description: Current per line signalled on the CP: 0 or 6000-32000 mA.

registers.name: EVSE: Granted Power
registers.description: Power allowed over all active lines per the CP signal (1380-22080 W at 230 V).

registers.name: Charging: Duration
registers.description: Duration of the charging session.

registers.name: Charging: Energy
registers.description: Energy delivered in the charging session.

registers.name: EMS-Control: Control-Register
registers.description: Write 0x8000 to hand control to the energy manager; default 0x0000 (off).

registers.name: EMS-Control: Setpoint Relais-Matrix
registers.description: Lines used with the current setpoint; L2 and L3 marked reserved for future. Default 0x0007.

registers.name: EMS-Control: Setpoint Charging Current
registers.description: 0 pauses, 6000-32000 mA charges, 0xFFFF cancels; default = power-class maximum.

registers.name: EMS-Control: Timeout Period
registers.description: 0 = timeout off (default); each setpoint write restarts the timer.

registers.name: EMS-Control: Timeout Fallback Pattern
registers.description: Lines used after a timeout; default 0x0007 (3 lines).

registers.name: EMS-Control: Timeout Fallback Current
registers.description: Current applied after a timeout: 0 or 6000-32000 mA, default 6000.

integration.summary: Enable the Modbus server in easyOperate, write 0x8000 to 0x00A0 to take EMS control, then write the charging current in mA to 0x00A2 (0 pauses). Read 0x0060 for state, 0x0066 for granted power and 0x0069 for session energy.
integration.enable: The Modbus server is switched on or off in the easyOperate configuration panel; it is disabled by factory default. EMS control itself is enabled by writing 0x8000 to 0x00A0.
integration.watchdog: If 0x00A3 is set above 0, each setpoint write restarts a timer of that many seconds; when it runs out the wallbox charges with the fallback current in 0x00A5 (default 6000 mA) on the lines in 0x00A4. The default 0 disables the timeout.
quirks: Current setpoints are in milliamps, not amps or tenths of amps.
Writing 0xFFFF to 0x00A2 cancels the charge; 0 only pauses it.
The unit ID is ignored today, but 0 is recommended for future firmware.
setup: Connect to the wallbox IP address on TCP port 502.
gotchas: Meter values (0x0030 on) are floats with no stated word order; check against the display before using them.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
